response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.zoneref) as site_count FROM scanconservation sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT COALESCE(insurstat, 'Missing') as status, site_count as count, site_count * 1.0 / SUM(site_count) OVER () as share FROM status_counts
